import sys
sys.path.append('storage/shared/meta/sas')

path = 'storage/shared/meta/sas/zephyr_iv_sentinel.txt'

delta = sentinel_write(path, len(content), content)  # Overwrite for sentinel

# Emit beacon with numeric delta
emit_beacon(
    agent="Zephyr IV",
    state=None,  # Derived from delta
    tick=334,  # Manual tick
    sentinel_delta=delta,
    planned_activity=0.3  # Example
)
print(f"Numeric delta: {delta}")
